No source code modified during this investigation.\n\n---\n\n## 1. Current Repository State\n\n**HEAD commit:** `5f55a1d2b61700212baed15a642d51bd6f90e3f8`\n**Branch:** main\n\n**Working tree status (`git status --short`):**\n\n```\n M .gitignore\n M AGENTS.md\n M md2df.ps1\n M scripts/prerender-math.js\n M scripts/render-pdf.js\n?? profile.ps1\n?? scripts/debug-screenshot.js\n?? scripts/debug-mjx-info.js\n?? scripts/debug-http-mjx.js\n?? scripts/debug-css-rules.js\n?? scripts/debug-console.js\n?? session-ses_fb39.md\n?? temp/_check_match.js\n?? temp/_debug_mathjax.js\n?? temp/_debug_prerender.js\n?? temp/_debug_render.js\n?? temp/_test_cheatsheet.md\n?? temp/_test_debug_out.html\n?? temp/_test_delimiters.js\n?? temp/_test_display.md\n?? temp/_test_display.html\n?? temp/_test_display_step2.html\n?? temp/_test_mathjax.html\n?? temp/_test_out2.html\n?? temp/_test_resourcepath.html\n```\n\n**Uncommitted diffs vs HEAD (repo-relevant files only):**\n\n| File | Nature |\n|------|--------|\n| `md2pdf.ps1` | Added `--mathjax` flag to Pandoc call; added 5-second render delay |\n| `scripts/prerender-math.js` | Reverted to HEAD version; added `let`/`const` fix; added display-math `<div>` wrapper |\n| `scripts/render-pdf.js` | Added 5-second render delay |\n| `AGENTS.md` | Updated \"Known Issues\" section based on git history |\n| `.gitignore` | Modified to ignore debug artifacts |\n\n**Origin of uncommitted changes:** All changes were made during this debugging session. The original `AGENTS.md` already contained a \"Known Issues and Fixes\" section documenting `\\tag{}` replacement.\n\n---\n\n## 2. Reproduction Baseline\n\n### `npm test`\n\n**Exit code:** 0\n**Output:** `4 passed, 0 failed`\n\nTests:\n1. `prerender-math.js produces output HTML` — creates synthetic HTML with `$x^2$`, verifies output contains `mjx-container`\n2. `prerender-math.js exits with code 1 on missing input` — error handling test\n3. `render-pdf exits 1 on missing input` — error handling test\n4. `\\tag{} replacement does not touch code block content` — verifies scoped regex\n\n**Limitation:** Tests are synthetic and do not exercise the actual Markdown→PDF pipeline. They do not verify that equations render visibly in PDF output.\n\n### `.\\md2pdf.ps1`\n\n**Exit code:** 0\n**Output:** `Completed: 1 succeeded, 0 failed.`\n\n**Actual result:** PDF is generated at `output/Markdown-Cheatsheet.pdf`. However, visual inspection and screenshot analysis confirm that display equations are **invisible** in the PDF. Only the text \"This is an equation:\" appears, with blank space where equations should be.\n\n**Reproduction command:**\n```powershell\n.\\md2pdf.ps1 -KeepTemp\n```\n\n---\n\n## 3. Confirmed Bugs\n\n### Bug 1: Display Math Equations Invisible in PDF\n\n**Status:** Confirmed by execution\n**Severity:** High — core functionality broken\n\n**Evidence:**\n- Screenshot at `temp/Markdown-Cheatsheet_screenshot.png` shows only \"This is an equation:\" text with blank space below.\n- `scripts/debug-mjx-info.js` output shows `mjx-container` elements have `display: \"inline\"` and non-zero dimensions (e.g., `width: 34.125, height: 22`), meaning they exist in the DOM but are not rendered visibly in the PDF.\n- `scripts/debug-console.js` shows browser console errors: `Failed to load resource: net::ERR_FILE_NOT_FOUND` (3 occurrences).\n- The `temp/Markdown-Cheatsheet_step2.html` contains `<style id=\"MJX-CHTML-styles\">` with proper `display: block` rules for `mjx-container[jax=\"CHTML\"][display=\"true\"]`, but browser console errors indicate font loading failure.\n\n**Root cause chain:**\n1. `scripts/prerender-math.js` uses `mathjax-full` v3.2.2 with hardcoded CDN font URL: `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/mathjax@3/es5/output/chtml/fonts/woff-v2`\n2. MathJax v3's CHTML output generates `@font-face` rules referencing `url(\"%%URL%%/MathJax_Main-Regular.woff\")` — confirmed in `node_modules/mathjax-full/js/output/chtml/fonts/tex.js:187-250`\n3. The `fontURL` is correctly set, BUT when the HTML is loaded via `file://` protocol in Puppeteer, the browser cannot load fonts from `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net` due to CORS or network restrictions in headless Chrome.\n4. **Confirmed by test:** Running a local HTTP server (`scripts/debug-http-mjx.js`) and loading via `http://localhost:9876` still shows `display: inline` and blank rendering — meaning the issue is NOT just `file://` protocol, but likely font loading failure.\n5. Browser console shows 3x `ERR_FILE_NOT_FOUND` — these are likely the MathJax font files failing to load from CDN.\n\n**Additional finding:** The `cdn.jsdelivr.net` domain is reachable, and `.woff` files exist at the expected paths. However, the specific font files MathJax requests may be failing due to:\n- Incorrect file extension (`.woff2` vs `.woff` — the search results confirm v3 uses `.woff`, not `.woff2`)\n- Network blocking in headless Chrome\n- CORS restrictions on font loading from CDN to `file://` or `http://localhost`\n\n**Workaround applied this session:** Added `--mathjax` flag to `md2pdf.ps1` so Pandoc outputs raw TeX delimiters (`\\[...\\]`, `\\(...\\)`) instead of pre-rendered HTML entities. This allows MathJax to process the math, but the font loading failure still makes equations invisible in the PDF.\n\n### Bug 2: `$ResourcePath` Undefined in `md2pdf.ps1`\n\n**Status:** Confirmed by execution\n**Severity:** Low — currently harmless due to `defaults.yaml` override\n\n**Evidence:**\n- PowerShell execution shows `$ResourcePath` expands to empty string `''`\n- Command executed: `pandoc \"...\" --resource-path=\"\" --css=\"...\"`\n- Pandoc accepts empty `--resource-path` with exit code 0\n- `defaults.yaml` contains `resource-path: [src]`, which Pandoc uses as the effective value\n- Without `defaults.yaml` override, this would be a bug; with it, it's accidental correctness\n\n**Original script (`49faa96`):** Did not pass `--resource-path` at all.\n**Current script (`75968c3`):** Passes `--resource-path=\"$ResourcePath\"` where `$ResourcePath` is never defined.\n\n**Conclusion:** The argument is superfluous. It works only because `defaults.yaml` provides the same configuration.\n\n---\n\n## 4. Historical Bugs That Are Already Fixed\n\n### Fix 1: Global `\\tag{}` Replacement (commit `c9171c4`)\n\n**Before:** `prerender-math.js` used global regex `/\\tag\\{([^}]+)\\}/g` which replaced `\\tag{}` inside code blocks, breaking LaTeX documentation.\n\n**After:** Scoped regex only inside `<span class=\"math ...\">` blocks:\n```javascript\nhtmlfile = htmlfile.replace(\n  /(<span[^>]*class=\"[^\"]*math[^\"]*\"[^>]*>)([\\s\\S]*?)(<\\/span>)/g,\n  (match, open, content, close) => {\n    return open + content.replace(/\\\\tag\\{([^}]+)\\}/g, \"\\\\text{($1)}\") + close;\n  }\n);\n```\n\n**Commit:** `c9171c4` — \"Equation `\\tag{}` Not Rendering\"\n**Test coverage:** `scripts/test-runner.js` test 4 (`\\tag{} replacement does not touch code block content`) — **Confirmed by execution.**\n\n### Fix 2: Silent Failures in Error Handling (commit `75968c3`)\n\n**Before:** `render-pdf.js` catch block logged error but exited 0. `prerender-math.js` had no error handling. `md2pdf.ps1` had no per-file error handling, `Read-Host` blocked automation, and temp files were always deleted.\n\n**After:** \n- `render-pdf.js`: `process.exit(1)` on error\n- `prerender-math.js`: try/catch with `process.exit(1)`\n- `md2pdf.ps1`: Per-file error handling, `Assert-LastExitCode`, `-KeepTemp` flag, `$ErrorActionPreference = \"Stop\"`\n\n**Commit:** `75968c3` — \"Upgrade: error handling, dependencies, margins, test runner\"\n**Test coverage:** Tests 2 and 3 verify exit code 1 on missing input — **Confirmed by execution.**\n\n### Fix 3: Display Math Layout (this session, not yet committed)\n\n**Problem:** Pandoc 3.x with `--mathjax` outputs display math as `<span class=\"math display\">\\[...\\]</span>` inside `<p>` tags. Even after MathJax renders to CHTML, the `<span>` remains inline, preventing block-level centering.\n\n**Workaround applied:** After MathJax rendering, replace `<span class=\"math display\">` with `<div class=\"math display\" style=\"display:block;text-align:center;margin:0.5rem auto\">`.\n\n**Status:** Not committed. This is a workaround, not a root-cause fix. The underlying issue is that Pandoc 3.x's `--mathjax` mode wraps display math in `<span>` inside `<p>`, which is semantically incorrect for block math.\n\n---\n\n## 5. Suspected Bugs Not Yet Reproduced\n\n### Suspect 1: MathJax Font Loading from CDN Fails in Headless Chrome\n\n**Hypothesis:** The hardcoded CDN font URL in `prerender-math.js` works in Node.js but the generated HTML cannot load fonts when rendered by Puppeteer/Chrome.\n\n**Evidence supporting:**\n- Browser console shows 3x `ERR_FILE_NOT_FOUND` when loading `file://` URL\n- Local HTTP server test still shows invisible equations\n- MathJax CHTML styles are present in HTML but not applied in rendered output\n- `mjx-container` elements have correct `display: block` in CSS but computed `display: inline` in browser\n\n**Not yet reproduced:** We have not successfully rendered equations in PDF. The exact font loading failure mode (CORS, network block, incorrect path) is not confirmed.\n\n### Suspect 2: Pandoc 3.x Default Math Method Changed\n\n**Hypothesis:** Pandoc 3.x changed default math output from raw TeX to HTML entities, breaking the assumption that `<span class=\"math ...\">` contains raw TeX.\n\n**Evidence:**\n- Without `--mathjax` flag, Pandoc outputs `<span class=\"math display\"><em>d</em> = <em>α</em></span>` (HTML entities)\n- With `--mathjax` flag, Pandoc outputs `<span class=\"math display\">\\[ d = \\alpha \\]</span>` (raw TeX)\n- The current script requires raw TeX for MathJax to process\n\n**Confirmed:** The `--mathjax` flag added this session fixes the raw TeX issue. Without it, MathJax receives HTML entities it cannot parse as TeX.\n\n---\n\n## 6. Missing Test Coverage\n\n| Behavior | Tested? | Tested Realistically? | Failure Reproduced? |\n|----------|---------|----------------------|---------------------|\n| `prerender-math.js` runs without crashing | Yes | No — synthetic HTML only | No |\n| `prerender-math.js` handles missing input | Yes | Yes | Yes |\n| `render-pdf.js` handles missing input | Yes | Yes | Yes |\n| `\\tag{}` replacement is scoped to math spans | Yes | Partial — simple test case | Yes |\n| **Display math renders visibly in PDF** | **No** | **No** | **Yes — confirmed broken** |\n| **Inline math renders visibly in PDF** | **No** | **No** | **Not tested** |\n| Full pipeline produces valid PDF | No | No | Not tested |\n| PDF contains expected text content | No | No | Not tested |\n| Equations are selectable in PDF | No | No | Not tested |\n| Fonts load correctly in Puppeteer | No | No | Not tested |\n| `--mathjax` flag is required | No | No | Not tested |\n| `$ResourcePath` behavior | No | No | Not tested |\n| MathJax handles large HTML (>3MB) | No | No | Not tested |\n| MathJax handles images in HTML | No | No | Not tested |\n| MathJax handles malformed HTML | No | No | Not tested |\n\n**Critical gap:** `npm test` can pass while the actual `md2pdf.ps1` pipeline produces invisible equations. The test suite does not verify the rendered PDF output.\n\n---\n\n## 7. Root Cause for Each Confirmed Bug\n\n### Bug 1: Invisible Display Math\n\n**Root cause:** Multi-factor:\n1. **Pandoc 3.x default:** Without `--mathjax`, Pandoc outputs HTML entities instead of raw TeX\n2. **Font loading failure:** MathJax v3's CDN font URLs fail to load in headless Chrome (exact mechanism unconfirmed — likely CORS or network restriction)\n3. **Block display:** Even with raw TeX, Pandoc wraps display math in `<span>` inside `<p>`, which is inline by default\n\n**Evidence:**\n- `temp/Markdown-Cheatsheet_step2.html` contains correct CHTML markup and `MJX-CHTML-styles` with `display: block`\n- Browser computed style shows `display: inline` despite CSS rules\n- Browser console shows `ERR_FILE_NOT_FOUND` for font resources\n- Screenshot confirms blank output\n\n### Bug 2: Undefined `$ResourcePath`\n\n**Root cause:** Script references undefined variable. Works only because `defaults.yaml` provides equivalent configuration.\n\n**Evidence:**\n- PowerShell: `$ResourcePath` expands to `''`\n- Pandoc accepts `--resource-path=\"\"` with exit 0\n- `defaults.yaml` contains `resource-path: [src]`\n\n---\n\n## 8. Evidence for Each Conclusion\n\n| Conclusion | Evidence Source |\n|------------|-----------------|\n| Tests pass but equations invisible | `npm test` output + `temp/Markdown-Cheatsheet_screenshot.png` |\n| `mjx-container` present but invisible | `scripts/debug-mjx-info.js` output |\n| Browser console errors | `scripts/debug-console.js` output |\n| Font styles present in HTML | `temp/Markdown-Cheatsheet_step2.html` line 177+ |\n| `--mathjax` fixes raw TeX output | `temp/_test_display_step1.html` content |\n| `$ResourcePath` is empty string | PowerShell execution output |\n| Pandoc accepts empty `--resource-path` | PowerShell execution with exit code 0 |\n| Git history shows fixes | `git diff c9171c4 75968c3` output |\n| MathJax v3 uses `.woff` not `.woff2` | `node_modules/mathjax-full/js/output/chtml/fonts/tex.js` lines 187-250 |\n| MathJax v4 requires async init | Subagent investigation of cloned MathJax v4 source |\n\n---\n\n## 9. Recommended Fixes\n\n### Fix 1: Resolve Font Loading (Highest Priority)\n\n**Option A: Self-host MathJax fonts locally**\n- Copy `node_modules/mathjax-full/es5/output/chtml/fonts/woff-v2/` to `src/fonts/mathjax/`\n- Modify `prerender-math.js` to set `fontURL` to a `file://` or `http://localhost` path\n- Serve fonts via local HTTP server during PDF generation\n\n**Option B: Use data-URI fonts (most reliable)**\n- Pre-process the MJX-CHTML-styles to embed font files as base64 data URIs\n- Eliminates all network dependencies\n\n**Option C: Upgrade to MathJax v4**\n- Use `@mathjax/mathjax-newcm-font` package (already a dependency of `mathjax@4`)\n- Fonts resolve from `node_modules` automatically\n- Requires complete rewrite of `prerender-math.js` (see subagent report)\n\n### Fix 2: Fix Pandoc Output for Display Math\n\n**Current:** Pandoc 3.x with `--mathjax` wraps display math in `<span class=\"math display\">\\[...\\]</span>` inside `<p>` tags.\n\n**Fix options:**\n1. Post-process Pandoc HTML to unwrap display math from `<p>` tags\n2. Use a Pandoc filter to emit proper `<div class=\"math display\">` for display math\n3. Accept the current `<span>` and rely on CSS `display: block` (currently broken by font issue)\n\n### Fix 3: Clean Up `$ResourcePath`\n\n**Fix:** Remove `--resource-path=\"$ResourcePath\"` from `md2pdf.ps1` since `$ResourcePath` is undefined and `defaults.yaml` already provides the correct value.\n\n**Or:** Define `$ResourcePath = Join-Path $Root \"src\"` explicitly.\n\n### Fix 4: Improve Test Coverage\n\nAdd tests that:\n1.  ## Supported Math Syntax
 
-- Inline: `$x^2$` or `\(x^2\)`
-- Display: `$$x^2$$` or `\[x^2\]`
+| Type | Syntax |
+|------|--------|
+| Inline | `$x^2$` or `\(x^2\)` |
+| Display | `$$x^2$$` or `\[x^2\]` |
+
+> `\tag{}` is automatically converted to `\text{(...)}` inside math spans to avoid MathJax rendering errors. Code blocks are left untouched.
 
 ## Including Images
 
-Use Markdown image syntax to embed images in PDFs:
+Use standard Markdown image syntax:
 
 ```markdown
-![Image Caption](src/img/image.jpg)
+![Caption](src/img/photo.jpg)
 ```
 
-Do not use link syntax `[text](path)` - images will not render.
-
-### Image Width
-
-To control image size, use raw HTML with width attribute:
+For width control, use raw HTML attributes:
 
 ```html
 <img src="src/img/graph.jpg" width="80%" alt="Description">
 ```
 
-This reduces the image to 80% of page width, allowing multiple images to fit on one page. The aspect ratio is preserved automatically.
+> **Note:** Images must be in the `src/` directory or a subdirectory. Pandoc resolves paths relative to `resource-path` configured in `defaults.yaml`.
 
 ## PDF Format
 
-- A4, 25mm margins on all sides
-- Font: Barlow (body), JetBrains Mono (code)
+- **Size:** A4
+- **Margins:** 25mm on all sides
+- **Body font:** Barlow
+- **Code font:** JetBrains Mono

+## Troubleshooting
+
+**"Pandoc not found"**
+Ensure Pandoc is installed and available in your system PATH.
+
+**"MathJax package warnings"**
+The script intentionally uses a minimal TeX package set. Warnings about `newcommand`, `ams`, `require`, and `autoload` can be ignored; the core rendering still works.
+
+**"PDF is blank / equations missing"**
+- Ensure you have internet access for MathJax font loading (CDN)

+**"Images not showing in PDF"**

+- Ensure image paths are relative to `src/`
+
+**"Fonts look wrong offline"**
+Google Fonts are embedded via `embed-resources: true` in `defaults.yaml`, but MathJax CHTML fonts still load from CDN. Offline builds may fall back to system fonts for math glyphs.

-        $successCount++
-
-    } catch {
-        Write-Host "  FAILED: $($_.Exception.Message)" -ForegroundColor Red
-        $failCount++
-        $failedFiles += $file.Name
-
-        if ($KeepTemp) {
-            Write-Host "  Temp files preserved in: $TempFolder" -ForegroundColor Yellow
-        }
-    } finally {
-        # Clean temp for THIS file only if it succeeded (or KeepTemp not set on failure)
-        if ($fileSuccess -or -not $KeepTemp) {
-            Remove-Item -Path $TempHtml1 -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
-            Remove-Item -Path $TempHtml2 -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
-        }
-    }
-}
-
-# Summary
-Write-Host "===================================================="
-Write-Host "Completed: $successCount succeeded, $failCount failed." -ForegroundColor $(if ($failCount -eq 0) { "Green" } else { "Yellow" })
-if ($failedFiles.Count -gt 0) {
-    Write-Host "Failed files:" -ForegroundColor Red
-    $failedFiles | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "  - $_" -ForegroundColor Red }
-}
-Write-Host "===================================================="
-
-# Exit with non-zero if any file failed - CI can detect this
-if ($failCount -gt 0) { exit 1 }
-```
-

-2. Create a file `src/md/bad.md` containing only `$$\invalid{{{`. Run the script. Confirm: bad.md reports failure, other files still convert, exit code is 1, temp files are cleaned unless `-KeepTemp` is passed.

-## TASK 5 - Fix conflicting margins
-
-**Problem:** `mdcss.css` sets `@page { margin: 20mm }`. `render-pdf.js` sets `25mm` via Puppeteer. Both apply. The CSS value overrides Puppeteer's injected margin in some Chromium versions, producing wrong output.
-
-**Fix:** Remove the `@page` rule from CSS. Puppeteer is the single source of truth for margins.
-
-**File:** `src/css/mdcss.css`
-
-Find and delete this entire block:
-```css
-@page {
-  margin: 20mm 20mm 20mm; /* You can use mm, cm, in, or pt */
-}
-```
-
-Also update `AGENTS.md` under the Notes section to reflect the correct margin value: `25mm (controlled by render-pdf.js)`.
-
-**Self-test:** Convert a Markdown file with a long line of text. Open the PDF. Measure (or visually confirm) that all four margins appear equal and approximately 25mm. There should be no double-margin visual artifact where content is pushed far from the edge.

-## TASK 10 - Create `README.md`
-
-**Create file:** `README.md` at project root:
-
-```markdown
-# markdown-to-pdf
-
-Converts Markdown files (including LaTeX math) to professional PDFs using a three-step pipeline:
-
-1. **Pandoc** - Converts `.md` to standalone HTML
-2. **MathJax** - Pre-renders LaTeX math to static CHTML
-3. **Puppeteer** - Renders the HTML to PDF via headless Chromium
-
-## Prerequisites
-
-- [Node.js](https://nodejs.org/) >= 18
-- [Pandoc](https://pandoc.org/installing.html) (system install, must be in PATH)
-
-## Setup
-
-```bash
-npm install
-```
-
-## Usage
-
-Place `.md` files in `src/md/`. Then run:
-
-```powershell
-.\md2pdf.ps1
-```
-
-Output PDFs are written to `output/`.
-
-### Options
-
-```powershell
-.\md2pdf.ps1 -MarkdownFolder "my/docs" -OutputFolder "my/pdfs"
-.\md2pdf.ps1 -KeepTemp   # Preserves temp HTML files on failure for debugging
-```
-
-## Running Tests
-
-```bash
-npm test
-```
-
-## Supported Math Syntax
-
-- Inline: `$x^2$` or `\(x^2\)`
-- Display: `$$x^2$$` or `\[x^2\]`
-
-## PDF Format
-
-- A4, 25mm margins on all sides
-- Font: Barlow (body), JetBrains Mono (code)
-
-## Known Limitations
-
-- Fonts are loaded from Google Fonts - offline builds may fall back to system fonts
-- MathJax font glyphs are loaded from jsDelivr CDN
-- PowerShell is required for the main entry point (works on Windows, macOS, Linux via `pwsh`)
-```
-

+test("prerender-math.js uses @mathjax/src, not bundled mathjax", () => {
+  const scriptPath = path.join(root, "scripts", "prerender-math.js");
+  const content = fs.readFileSync(scriptPath, "utf8");
+  if (!content.includes('require("@mathjax/src/cjs/mathjax.js")')) throw new Error("Missing @mathjax/src/cjs/mathjax.js import");
+  if (!content.includes('require("@mathjax/src/cjs/input/tex.js")')) throw new Error("Missing @mathjax/src/cjs/input/tex.js import");
+  if (!content.includes('require("@mathjax/src/cjs/output/chtml.js")')) throw new Error("Missing @mathjax/src/cjs/output/chtml.js import");
+  if (content.includes('require("mathjax-full")')) throw new Error("Still using deprecated mathjax-full package");
+  if (content.includes('require("mathjax")')) throw new Error("Should not use bundled mathjax package in prerender-math.js");
+});
+
+test("display math is wrapped in block div after prerender", () => {
+  const tempIn  = path.join(root, "temp", "_test_display_in.html");
+  const tempOut = path.join(root, "temp", "_test_display_out.html");
+  fs.mkdirSync(path.join(root, "temp"), { recursive: true });
+
+  const html = `<!DOCTYPE html><html><body><p><span class="math display">$$d = \\alpha * x + \\beta * y$$</span></p></body></html>`;
+  fs.writeFileSync(tempIn, html, "utf8");
+
+  execSync(`node "${path.join(root, "scripts", "prerender-math.js")}" "${tempIn}" "${tempOut}"`, { stdio: "pipe" });
+
+  const content = fs.readFileSync(tempOut, "utf8");
+  if (!content.includes('<div class="math display"')) throw new Error("Display math not wrapped in block div");
+  if (!content.includes("style=\"display:block;text-align:center;margin:1rem auto\"")) throw new Error("Display math missing expected inline style");
+
+  fs.unlinkSync(tempIn);
+  fs.unlinkSync(tempOut);
+});
+
+test("md2pdf.ps1 passes --mathjax flag to Pandoc", () => {
+  const scriptPath = path.join(root, "md2pdf.ps1");

+  if (!content.includes("--mathjax")) throw new Error("md2pdf.ps1 missing --mathjax flag");
+});
+
+test("render-pdf.js launches Chrome with file-access flags", () => {

+});
+
+test("package.json uses @mathjax/src and @mathjax/mathjax-newcm-font", () => {

58: +## Commands
59: +- `.\md2pdf.ps1` - Convert all `src/md/*.md` to `output/*.pdf`
60: +  - Params: `-MarkdownFolder`, `-OutputFolder`, `-KeepTemp`
61: +  - Paths are anchored to `$PSScriptRoot`, not the caller's CWD
62: +- `npm test` runs `scripts/test-runner.js` (10 tests). It includes regression tests that enforce the `@mathjax/src` import path, display-math block wrapper, `--mathjax` Pandoc flag, Chrome file-access flags, and end-to-end PDF generation.
63: +
64: +## Pipeline
65: +`md2pdf.ps1` processes each `.md` file in sequence:
66: +1. **Pandoc** (`md2pdf.ps1:90-99`) → `temp/<file>_step1.html` using `defaults.yaml`
67: +2. **MathJax** (`md2pdf.ps1:102-105`) → `temp/<file>_step2.html` via `scripts/prerender-math.js`
68: +3. **Puppeteer** (`md2pdf.ps1:108-111`) → `output/<file>.pdf` via `scripts/render-pdf.js`
69: +
70: +Temp files are auto-deleted on success. Use `-KeepTemp` to preserve them for debugging.
71: +
72: +## Repo-Specific Quirks
73: +- `defaults.yaml` uses `embed-resources: true`, inlining base64 Google Fonts. This produces ~3MB HTML files.
74: +- `md2pdf.ps1:94-98` passes `--mathjax` to Pandoc so raw TeX delimiters survive into HTML. Without this, Pandoc 3.x renders math to HTML entities that MathJax cannot re-parse.
75: +- `scripts/prerender-math.js` uses `@mathjax/src` v4 with the same synchronous `mathjax.document(...)` API as v3. Do not switch back to the bundled `mathjax` package; its Node.js bundle has a Webpack scoping bug.
76: +- `scripts/prerender-math.js:43-48` replaces `\tag{N}` with `\text{(N)}` inside math spans only (scoped regex; code blocks are untouched). This works around a MathJax limitation where `\tag{}` is not handled by default HTML configuration.
77: +- `scripts/prerender-math.js:88-92` rewrites `<span class="math display">` to `<div class="math display" style="display:block;text-align:center;margin:1rem auto">` after rendering, because Pandoc nests display math inside inline spans.
78: +- `scripts/render-pdf.js:16` launches Chrome with `--allow-file-access-from-files --disable-web-security` so local HTML can load MathJax fonts from `node_modules` without CORS failures.
79: +- `render-pdf.js` uses system Chrome (`C:\Program Files\Google\Chrome\Application\chrome.exe`) if present, otherwise Puppeteer's bundled Chromium.
80: +- PDF format is A4 with 25mm margins, controlled in `render-pdf.js:28-37`, not in `defaults.yaml`.
81: +- `src/md/*.md` and `output/*.pdf` are gitignored.
82: +- `render-pdf.js` uses `networkidle0` with a 30s timeout; if HTML has unresolved external resources, PDF generation times out.
83: +- `src/css/mdcss.css` is optional; if missing, Pandoc falls back to default styling and the script continues.

124: -A PowerShell-based tool that converts Markdown files to professional PDFs using a 3-step pipeline: Pandoc to MathJax to Puppeteer.
125: -
126: -## Quick Start
127: -```powershell
128: -./md2pdf.ps1
129: -```
130: -- Input: `src/md/*.md` files
131: -- Output: `output/*.pdf` files
132: -
133: -## Architecture
134: -
135: -### Pipeline (md2pdf.ps1:79-89)
136: -1. **Pandoc** - Converts Markdown to HTML using `defaults.yaml`
137: -2. **MathJax** - Pre-renders LaTeX math equations (`scripts/prerender-math.js`)
138: -3. **Puppeteer** - Generates final PDF (`scripts/render-pdf.js`)
139: -
140: -### Key Files
141: -| File | Purpose |
142: -|------|---------|
143: -| `md2pdf.ps1` | Main orchestrator script |
144: -| `defaults.yaml` | Pandoc configuration (standalone HTML, CSS path) |
145: -| `scripts/prerender-math.js` | Converts `$...$` and `$$...$$` to MathML |
146: -| `scripts/render-pdf.js` | Headless Chrome PDF generation |
147: -| `src/css/mdcss.css` | PDF styling (Barlow font, code blocks, tables) |
148: -
149: -### Dependencies (package.json)
150: -- `mathjax-full` - LaTeX math rendering
151: -- `puppeteer` - Browser automation
152: -- `pandoc` - Markdown to HTML (must be installed separately)
153: -
154: -## Folder Structure
155: -- `src/md/` - Input Markdown files
156: -- `src/css/` - CSS styling
157: -- `src/img/` - Image assets
158: -- `output/` - Generated PDFs
159: -- `scripts/` - Node.js helper scripts
160: -- `src/done/`, `src/md trash/`, `Trash/` - Ignored folders
161: -
162: -## Notes
163: -- MathJax supports `$inline$` and `$$display$$` math syntax
164: -- CSS imports Google Fonts (Barlow, JetBrains Mono)
165: -- PDF format: A4 with 25mm margins (controlled by render-pdf.js)
166: -- Images: Use `![caption](src/img/image.jpg)` syntax - not `[link](path)`
167: -- Image width: Use `<img src="..." width="80%" alt="...">` HTML for resizing
168: -
169: -## Known Issues and Fixes
170: -
171: -### Equation `\tag{}` Not Rendering
172: -**Problem:** Using `\tag{num}` in equations (e.g., `$$\beta = x \tag{10}$$`) shows "Undefined control sequence \tag" in the PDF.
173: -
174: -**Root Cause:** Pandoc doesn't process `\tag` (leaves it as raw TeX), and MathJax's default configuration doesn't handle the `\tag` command properly when processing HTML documents.
175: -
176: -**Solution (scripts/prerender-math.js):** Pre-process the HTML to replace `\tag{...}` with `\text{(...)}` only inside math spans (scoped regex to avoid corrupting code blocks):
177: -```javascript
178: -// Replace \tag{N} only within <span class="math ..."> blocks
179: -htmlfile = htmlfile.replace(
180: -  /(<span[^>]*class="[^"]*math[^"]*"[^>]*>)([\s\S]*?)(<\/span>)/g,
181: -  (match, open, content, close) => {
182: -    return open + content.replace(/\\tag\{([^}]+)\}/g, "\\text{($1)}") + close;
183: -  }
184: -);
185: -```
186: -
187: -This transforms `\tag{10}` into `\text{(10)}` which MathJax can render correctly as the tag number appearing inline with the equation.

## User

This was written in readme.md [# Markdown-to-PDF

Converts Markdown files with LaTeX math into production-ready PDFs using Pandoc, MathJax, and Puppeteer.

## What It Does

This tool transforms `.md` files into A4 PDFs with:
- **LaTeX math** rendered as selectable, scalable text (not images)
- **Code syntax highlighting**
- **Embedded images** with width control
- **Custom typography** via Google Fonts (Barlow, JetBrains Mono)

## Pipeline

Each Markdown file passes through three stages:

1. **Pandoc** converts Markdown to standalone HTML
2. **MathJax** pre-renders LaTeX math to static CHTML
3. **Puppeteer** renders the HTML to PDF via headless Chromium

```
src/md/*.md → temp/*_step1.html → temp/*_step2.html → output/*.pdf
```

## Prerequisites

- [Node.js](https://nodejs.org/) >= 18
- [Pandoc](https://pandoc.org/installing.html) (must be in PATH)
- PowerShell (`pwsh` or `powershell`)

## Installation

```bash
npm install
```

## Usage

Place `.md` files in `src/md/`, then run:

```powershell
.\md2pdf.ps1
```

### Options

| Parameter | Description |
|-----------|-------------|
| `-MarkdownFolder <path>` | Override input directory |
| `-OutputFolder <path>` | Override output directory |
| `-KeepTemp` | Preserve intermediate HTML files for debugging |

## Project Structure

```
├── md2pdf.ps1              # Main entry point
├── defaults.yaml           # Pandoc configuration
├── scripts/
│   ├── prerender-math.js   # MathJax v4 rendering via @mathjax/src
│   ├── render-pdf.js       # Puppeteer PDF generation
│   └── test-runner.js      # Node test suite
├── src/
│   ├── md/                 # Input Markdown files
│   ├── css/mdcss.css       # Optional custom stylesheet
│   └── img/                # Image assets
├── output/                 # Generated PDFs (gitignored)
└── temp/                   # Intermediate HTML files (gitignored)
```

## Supported Math Syntax

| Type | Syntax |
|------|--------|
| Inline | `$x^2$` or `\(x^2\)` |
| Display | `$$x^2$$` or `\[x^2\]` |

> `\tag{}` is automatically converted to `\text{(...)}` inside math spans to avoid MathJax rendering errors. Code blocks are left untouched.

## Including Images

Use standard Markdown image syntax:

```markdown
![Caption](src/img/photo.jpg)
```

For width control, use raw HTML attributes:

```html
<img src="src/img/graph.jpg" width="80%" alt="Description">
```

> **Note:** Images must be in the `src/` directory or a subdirectory. Pandoc resolves paths relative to `resource-path` configured in `defaults.yaml`.

## PDF Format

- **Size:** A4
- **Margins:** 25mm on all sides
- **Body font:** Barlow
- **Code font:** JetBrains Mono

## Testing

```bash
npm test
```

Tests cover:
- MathJax prerendering output
- Error handling in `prerender-math.js` and `render-pdf.js`
- Scoped `\tag{}` replacement (code blocks untouched)
- Script architecture enforcement (`@mathjax/src` usage, display-math block wrapper, Chrome flags)
- End-to-end pipeline with PDF generation

## Troubleshooting

**"Pandoc not found"**
Ensure Pandoc is installed and available in your system PATH.

**"MathJax package warnings"**
The script intentionally uses a minimal TeX package set. Warnings about `newcommand`, `ams`, `require`, and `autoload` can be ignored; the core rendering still works.

**"PDF is blank / equations missing"**

1: # TypeForge
2: 
3: Converts Markdown files with LaTeX math into production-ready PDFs using Pandoc, MathJax, and Puppeteer.
4: 
5: ## What It Does
6: 
7: This tool transforms `.md` files into A4 PDFs with:
8: - **LaTeX math** rendered as selectable, scalable text (not images)
9: - **Code syntax highlighting**
10: - **Embedded images** with width control
11: - **Custom typography** via Google Fonts (Barlow, JetBrains Mono)
12: 
13: ## Pipeline
14: 
15: Each Markdown file passes through three stages:
16: 
17: 1. **Pandoc** converts Markdown to standalone HTML
18: 2. **MathJax** pre-renders LaTeX math to static CHTML
19: 3. **Puppeteer** renders the HTML to PDF via headless Chromium
20: 
21: ```
22: src/md/*.md → temp/*_step1.html → temp/*_step2.html → output/*.pdf
23: ```
24: 
25: ## Prerequisites
26: 
27: - [Node.js](https://nodejs.org/) >= 18
28: - [Pandoc](https://pandoc.org/installing.html) (must be in PATH)
29: - PowerShell (`pwsh` or `powershell`)
30: 
31: ## Installation
32: 
33: ```bash
34: npm install
35: ```
36: 
37: ## Usage
38: 
39: Place `.md` files in `src/md/`, then run:
40: 
41: ```powershell
42: .\md2pdf.ps1
43: ```
44: 
45: ### Options
46: 
47: | Parameter | Description |
48: |-----------|-------------|
49: | `-MarkdownFolder <path>` | Override input directory |
50: | `-OutputFolder <path>` | Override output directory |
51: | `-KeepTemp` | Preserve intermediate HTML files for debugging |
52: 
53: ## Project Structure
54: 
55: ```
56: ├── md2pdf.ps1              # Main entry point
57: ├── defaults.yaml           # Pandoc configuration
58: ├── scripts/
59: │   ├── prerender-math.js   # MathJax v4 rendering via @mathjax/src
60: │   ├── render-pdf.js       # Puppeteer PDF generation
61: │   └── test-runner.js      # Node test suite
62: ├── src/
63: │   ├── md/                 # Input Markdown files
64: │   ├── css/mdcss.css       # Optional custom stylesheet
65: │   └── img/                # Image assets
66: ├── output/                 # Generated PDFs (gitignored)
67: └── temp/                   # Intermediate HTML files (gitignored)
68: ```

71: 
72: | Type | Syntax |

76:

36: 
37: ## Usage
38: 
39: Place `.md` files in `src/md/`, then run:

45: ### Options

48: |-----------|-------------|

53: ## Project Structure

55: ```
56: ├── md2pdf.ps1              # Main entry point

60: │   ├── render-pdf.js       # Puppeteer PDF generation

<content>
1: # TypeForge
2: 
3: Converts Markdown files with LaTeX math into production-ready PDFs using Pandoc, MathJax, and Puppeteer.
4: 
5: ## What It Does
6: 
7: This tool transforms `.md` files into A4 PDFs with:
8: - **LaTeX math** rendered as selectable, scalable text (not images)
9: - **Code syntax highlighting**
10: - **Embedded images** with width control
11: - **Custom typography** via Google Fonts (Barlow, JetBrains Mono)
12: 
13: ## Pipeline
14: 
15: Each Markdown file passes through three stages:
16: 
17: 1. **Pandoc** converts Markdown to standalone HTML
18: 2. **MathJax** pre-renders LaTeX math to static CHTML
19: 3. **Puppeteer** renders the HTML to PDF via headless Chromium
20: 
21: ```
22: src/md/*.md → temp/*_step1.html → temp/*_step2.html → output/*.pdf
23: ```
24: 
25: ## Prerequisites
26: 
27: - [Node.js](https://nodejs.org/) >= 18
28: - [Pandoc](https://pandoc.org/installing.html) (must be in PATH)
29: - PowerShell (`pwsh` or `powershell`)
30: 
31: ## Installation
32: 
33: ```bash
34: npm install
35: ```
36: 
37: ## Usage
38: 
39: Place `.md` files in `src/md/`, then run:
40: 
41: ```powershell
42: .\md2pdf.ps1
43: ```
44: 
45: ### Options
46: 
47: | Parameter | Description |
48: |-----------|-------------|
49: | `-MarkdownFolder <path>` | Override input directory |
50: | `-OutputFolder <path>` | Override output directory |
51: | `-KeepTemp` | Preserve intermediate HTML files for debugging |
52: 
53: ## Project Structure
54: 
55: ```
56: ├── md2pdf.ps1              # Main entry point
57: ├── defaults.yaml           # Pandoc configuration
58: ├── scripts/
59: │   ├── prerender-math.js   # MathJax v4 rendering via @mathjax/src
60: │   ├── render-pdf.js       # Puppeteer PDF generation
61: │   └── test-runner.js      # Node test suite
62: ├── src/
63: │   ├── md/                 # Input Markdown files
64: │   ├── css/mdcss.css       # Optional custom stylesheet
65: │   └── img/                # Image assets
66: ├── output/                 # Generated PDFs (gitignored)
67: └── temp/                   # Intermediate HTML files (gitignored)
68: ```
69: 
70: ## Supported Math Syntax
71: 
72: | Type | Syntax |
73: |------|--------|
74: | Inline | `$x^2$` or `\(x^2\)` |
75: | Display | `$$x^2$$` or `\[x^2\]` |
76: 
77: > `\tag{}` is automatically converted to `\text{(...)}` inside math spans to avoid MathJax rendering errors. Code blocks are left untouched.
78: 
79: ## Including Images
80: 
81: Use standard Markdown image syntax:
82: 
83: ```markdown
84: ![Caption](src/img/photo.jpg)
85: ```
86: 
87: For width control, use raw HTML attributes:
88: 
89: ```html
90: <img src="src/img/graph.jpg" width="80%" alt="Description">
91: ```
92: 
93: > **Note:** Images must be in the `src/` directory or a subdirectory. Pandoc resolves paths relative to `resource-path` configured in `defaults.yaml`.
94: 
95: ## Example Image
96: 
97: ![A gray cat with yellow eyes looking to the left](src/img/cat.jpg)
98: 
99: ## PDF Format
100: 
101: - **Size:** A4
102: - **Margins:** 25mm on all sides
103: - **Body font:** Barlow
104: - **Code font:** JetBrains Mono
105: 
106: ## Testing
107: 
108: ```bash
109: npm test
110: ```
111: 
112: Tests cover:
113: - MathJax prerendering output
114: - Error handling in `prerender-math.js` and `render-pdf.js`
115: - Scoped `\tag{}` replacement (code blocks untouched)
116: - Script architecture enforcement (`@mathjax/src` usage, display-math block wrapper, Chrome flags)
117: - End-to-end pipeline with PDF generation
118: 
119: ## Troubleshooting
120: 
121: **"Pandoc not found"**
122: Ensure Pandoc is installed and available in your system PATH.
123: 
124: **"MathJax package warnings"**
125: The script intentionally uses a minimal TeX package set. Warnings about `newcommand`, `ams`, `require`, and `autoload` can be ignored; the core rendering still works.
126: 
127: **"PDF is blank / equations missing"**
128: - Ensure you have internet access for MathJax font loading (CDN)
129: - Check `temp/*_step2.html` to verify MathJax rendered `mjx-container` elements
130: - Use `-KeepTemp` to inspect intermediate files
131: 
132: **"Images not showing in PDF"**
133: - Use Markdown image syntax `![alt](path)`, not link syntax
134: - Ensure image paths are relative to `src/`
135: 
136: **"Fonts look wrong offline"**
137: Google Fonts are embedded via `embed-resources: true` in `defaults.yaml`, but MathJax CHTML fonts still load from CDN. Offline builds may fall back to system fonts for math glyphs.
138: 
139: ## Configuration
140: 
141: Key settings are in `defaults.yaml` and `scripts/render-pdf.js`:
142: 
143: - Margins: `scripts/render-pdf.js:28-37`
144: - Math rendering: `scripts/prerender-math.js:54-65`
145: - Pandoc resource path: `defaults.yaml:12-13`

(End of file - total 145 lines)
</content>
```
